NewsItem.title: SunPeak opens a second regional service center
NewsItem.summary: Faster installs and maintenance across the eastern service area.
NewsItem.body: To keep installation lead times under two weeks, we have opened a second service center staffed with six additional certified installers.

NewsItem.title: New 25-year warranty on all monocrystalline panels
NewsItem.summary: Every panel now ships with an extended power warranty.
NewsItem.body: Starting this month, every SunPeak monocrystalline panel carries a 25-year linear power warranty, up from 20, at no extra cost to new customers.

pages.title: Company Introduction
pages.heading: SunPeak Solar
body: History: founded in 2014 by two solar engineers, SunPeak has installed systems for over 3,000 homes and businesses across the region.
Mission: make clean, self-generated power a practical choice for every roof, backed by hardware we would put on our own homes.
Values: transparent pricing, a 25-year warranty on our panels, and local service centers so a technician is never more than a day away.
